lines.en: I lead the way, walking at the front.

lines.zh: 这条巷子我闭眼都能走。
lines.en: I could walk this alley with my eyes shut.
I turn past the well and wave you along.
I keep a slow pace so you do not fall behind.
Grass grows between the stones; I step around.

lines.zh: 我抬手指了指前面的方向。
lines.en: I raise a hand and point the way ahead.
The path is cleaner today than yesterday.
I reach the village gate and turn back for you.

lines.zh: 村外的路要小心，我先探。
lines.en: The outside road is risky; I scout it first.
I carry a water skin enough for two.
I cross the mud and my soles grow heavy.
I follow the low wall around to the east.
I remember every loose brick along here.
This way is shorter and also safer.

lines.zh: 我靠着墙，看村里人来往。
lines.en: I lean on the wall and watch the village move.
When someone asks the way, I say it clearly.

lines.zh: 我在数今天进村几个人。
lines.en: I am counting how many entered today.

lines.zh: 太阳偏了，该叫他们回村。
lines.en: The sun tilts; time to call them back in.
I spread the map across my knees.
The Elsewhere night wind has a chill.

lines.zh: 我在等一对走散的旅人。
lines.en: I am waiting for two travelers who got separated.
Nothing much happened today; that is good.
I touch the whistle in my pocket.
The village children all know me.
I look into the distance and say nothing.
Smoke rises over there, and not from cooking.
I know which road leads where.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我就在想路。
lines.en: In quiet moments I think about roads.

lines.zh: 你是新来的，我看得出来。
lines.en: You are new here; I can tell.

lines.zh: 你的靴子还没沾这里的土。
lines.en: Your boots have not yet picked up our soil.

lines.zh: 我打量你，先看你的装备。
lines.en: I look you over, starting with your gear.
Do not worry; I am not here to collect money.
Where are you headed? I can point the way.

lines.zh: 你脸色不好，是不是累了？
lines.en: You look pale; are you tired?
I nod with a smile and wait for you to speak.

lines.zh: 你带的东西太少，路很长。
lines.en: You carry too little for such a long road.

lines.zh: 你的地图旧了，边都毛了。
lines.en: Your map is old; its edges are frayed.

lines.zh: 你看着我，是想要建议吧。
lines.en: You look at me; you want advice, I think.
Hesitation is plain in your eyes.
Sit down first, drink some water, then talk.
You do not look wicked, just lost.
I remember your face in case I need to find you.

lines.zh: 你把头盔摘了，我才看清你。
lines.en: You took off your helmet, so now I see you.

lines.zh: 你手上的伤，我这里有药。
lines.en: That wound on your hand; I have something for it.
Oh, these old bones of mine.
You struck the wrong one; I am a guide.
Stop; let me take you somewhere safe.
I back two steps and lean on the wall.
Blood drops on the stone; I wipe it away.
I shout once and the village will come.

lines.zh: 打得我胸口一闷，喘不上气。
lines.en: It knocks the wind right out of my chest.
Why strike a man who only guides?
I can still walk; do not mind me.
Pain or not, I still point the way.
Save that food for yourself; the road is long.
I take nothing; directions are free.
Take a bite of this flatbread before you go.
You hold that up; is it thanks?
Water for me? Then I will not refuse.

lines.zh: 我只要一句道谢就够了。
lines.en: A word of thanks is enough for me.
Put the money away; I do not keep accounts.
If you give it, I will share it with the village.
That smell makes my stomach growl.
Pack it away before the children see it.
Slow down; the lane is narrow and crowded.
You bumped into me; I do not mind.
Watch your step; there is a stair here.

lines.zh: 我撑住矮墙，才没有跌倒。
lines.en: I brace against the low wall and stay upright.
Do not push; there are people ahead.
My water skin was knocked off my shoulder.
One bump does not hurt; do not panic.
Make room; I will bring you through.
Careful, do not step on that cat.
With this many people, the road is hard.

lines.zh: 我的妻子在村西缝衣服。
lines.en: My wife sews clothes on the west side.

lines.zh: 我们在这条巷子里安了家。
lines.en: We made our home in this very alley.
She always says I talk too much.
She waits supper for me; I must go back.
We came here together from somewhere else.
She knows the roads better than I do.
The children run after travelers here.
I do my half of the housework.
She dislikes me guiding people at midnight.
With her beside me, no road feels long.
Whose button fell here, I wonder?
I pick it up and drop it in my bag.

lines.zh: 路边的果子，我拾了一个。
lines.en: I picked one fruit from the roadside.

lines.zh: 有人地图掉了，我追上去。
lines.en: Someone dropped a map; I hurry after them.

lines.zh: 我把石头挪开，免得绊人。
lines.en: I move the stone so nobody trips on it.
Found things must be asked about first.
This one I can mend a little.
It still seems useful; do not waste it.
I bend down and my knees creak once.
Return what you find; that is the rule.
A figure ahead; let me look first.

lines.zh: 你走错方向了，我拦住你。
lines.en: You are headed wrong; I stop you.

lines.zh: 我加快脚步，追上那个人。
lines.en: I quicken my pace to catch that person.

lines.zh: 有东西跟着你，我看见了。
lines.en: Something follows you; I have seen it.

lines.zh: 现在不是打招呼的时候。
lines.en: This is not the moment for pleasantries.
I grab your sleeve: do not go further.
The noise over there is not right.
I watch the alley mouth, waiting for it.

lines.zh: 我在意的是路，不是敌意。
lines.en: I mind the road, not the hostility.
Hold still and let me listen a moment.

lines.zh: 我压低声音，让你别出声。
lines.en: I lower my voice and tell you to be quiet.
It is at the corner; I count my breaths.
I tighten my grip on the wooden staff.
We go around the back, not straight on.
I watch it and ease my feet back.
Do not run; running only draws it after you.
I know this route; follow me.
I will go over first; you wait here.
It is watching us and pretending not to.
Hold steady; do not let it see fear.
I crack it once with my wooden staff.
This swing is only to buy time.
I am no warrior, but I can block.
Go now; I will hold this spot.
The staff snaps; I swing with my other hand.
I strike its eyes; that is where I can hit.
It steps back; we leave now.
I am gasping hard, but I can still swing.
Do not mind me; run for the village.
This one hit should be enough to free you.
Day breaks and I take my place at the gate.
Someone will need guiding again today.
I draw the bolt and welcome the travelers.
Elsewhere mornings are damp and heavy.
The village wakes, and so do I.
Will the first words be about the road again?
I hang the map back on the wall.
New travelers will find me here.
I stand in the old spot, never moved.
Another day, and the roads are the same.

lines.zh: 火顺着我的衣角爬上来。
lines.en: Fire climbs the hem of my coat.
I tumble down the stone steps.
I cannot swim; pull me out, now.
The blast presses me flat against the wall.
An arrow grazes my shoulder and tears my coat.
Magic takes the words right out of my mouth.
Too hungry to walk; how can I guide?
Lightning splits my wooden staff in two.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有路标，我迷了。
lines.en: No signposts in the void; I am lost.
